t: Sections 101, 102. and, as to distribution, sections 103 and 114 of this title shall be effective upon the date of approval of this Act. The remaining provisions of this title shall be effective upon the termination of title III of this Act.

fable.w: This section only sets effective dates for provisions of the title. A tempting reading is that "date of approval" implies some approval process involving outside parties, but it simply refers to enactment of the Act. No party outside the federal government is consulted or involved in any federal decision, and no rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue is created.
fable.s: The remaining provisions of this title shall be effective upon the termination of title III of this Act.

opus.w: This section only sets when provisions of the title take effect: some on the date the Act is approved, the rest when title III ends. No party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to object or sue. The phrase 'approval of this Act' means the Act's enactment, not approval by an outside party, so nothing here is participation.
